low.title: Full-Day Hallstatt Art Route on a Low Budget
low.summary: A simple, pretty, and affordable day through Hallstatt’s most photogenic corners, churches, and lakeside views with budget-friendly local bites.

schedule.title: Lakeside Promenade Wake-Up Walk
schedule.description: Start the day strolling along Hallstätter See, enjoying reflections of colorful houses and the iconic church tower — perfect for first photos.

schedule.title: Classic Postcard View & Old Town Alleys
schedule.description: Head to the classic postcard viewpoint, then wander the narrow streets to spot wooden balconies, painted façades, and cute details.

schedule.title: Budget Bakery Stop
schedule.description: Grab an inexpensive pastry or sandwich from a local bakery — fuel up without breaking the budget.

schedule.title: Artistic Church & Cemetery Views
schedule.description: Climb up to the parish church area and nearby cemetery for beautiful, quiet views over the rooftops and lake.

schedule.title: Low-Cost Local Lunch
schedule.description: Choose a simple Austrian dish like goulash, schnitzel, or daily menu in a modest gasthof.

schedule.title: World Heritage Museum Exterior & Village Details
schedule.description: If budget is tight, focus on the outside areas and nearby streets — signs, small sculptures, and historic boards tell the story visually.

schedule.title: Sunset by the Lake
schedule.description: Finish the day sitting by the water with takeaway snacks, watching the light fade over the mountains and village.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day Hallstatt Art Experience
medium.summary: A comfortable art-focused day with museum time, atmospheric streets, and solid local meals at medium prices.

schedule.title: Morning Coffee with Lake View
schedule.description: Start in a lakeside café, enjoying a warm drink while sketching or photographing the scenery.

schedule.title: Hallstatt Old Town Art & Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Explore Marktplatz, painted houses, wooden balconies, and small details that make the village look like a movie set.

schedule.title: World Heritage Museum – Cultural Highlights
schedule.description: Visit key sections of the museum to see artifacts, visuals, and exhibits that explain Hallstatt’s story.

schedule.title: Medium-Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a classic Austrian meal — maybe schnitzel, roast meat, or lake fish — in a mid-range restaurant.

schedule.title: Church Area & Artistic Viewpoints
schedule.description: Head up to the parish church terrace and nearby viewpoints for some of the best compositional angles of the town.

schedule.title: Small Artisan Shops & Craft Corners
schedule.description: Browse ceramic shops, woodcraft, or local design stores — even window shopping gives inspiration.

schedule.title: Evening Lakeside Promenade
schedule.description: Wrap up with a relaxed walk along the lake, capturing golden-hour reflections and calm village moods.

high.title: High-End Hallstatt Art Day
high.summary: A premium-feel art route with full museum visits, elevated local food, and the most scenic viewpoints in and above Hallstatt.

schedule.title: Quality Café Breakfast
schedule.description: Start with a proper sit-down breakfast in a stylish café, with a view of the lake or old town façades.

schedule.title: World Heritage Museum – Extended Visit
schedule.description: Take your time with the museum’s collections, focusing on visual displays, models, and historical artwork.

schedule.title: High-Quality Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy refined Austrian dishes made with care — lake fish, seasonal sides, and nicely presented plates.

schedule.title: Skywalk Artful Panorama
schedule.description: Ride the funicular or hike up to the Hallstatt Skywalk for a dramatic bird’s-eye view over the village, lake, and surrounding mountains.

schedule.title: Rudolfsturm & Mountain Atmosphere
schedule.description: Spend some time near the historic tower area, enjoying the architecture and mountain scenery from above.

schedule.title: Church, Cemetery & Village Photo Tour
schedule.description: Back in town, move between church terraces, narrow alleys, and balconies for the most elegant photo spots.

schedule.title: Golden-Hour Dinner by the Lake
schedule.description: End with a well-prepared dinner in a restaurant overlooking the water as the lights reflect in the lake.

comfortable.title: Luxury Full-Day Art Journey Through Hallstatt
comfortable.summary: A polished art-focused day including curated museum time, top viewpoints, refined dining, and plenty of photo-perfect locations.

schedule.title: Elegant Breakfast with Scenic View
schedule.description: Begin with a luxurious breakfast in a high-comfort hotel restaurant or café right by the lakeshore.

schedule.title: Guided or Curated Museum Exploration
schedule.description: Explore the World Heritage Museum in detail, focusing on artful displays, multimedia installations, and historic objects.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Local-Inspired Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a multi-course lunch that reinterprets Austrian classics with a modern, elegant twist.

schedule.title: Hallstatt Skywalk – Signature View
schedule.description: Head up to the Skywalk platform for panoramic views — ideal for pro-level photography and dramatic angles.

schedule.title: Calm Mountain Café or Terrace
schedule.description: Relax at a scenic terrace near the upper station or tower, soaking up the combination of architecture and alpine landscape.

schedule.title: Exclusive Old Town & Church Art Walk
schedule.description: Stroll through the most picturesque streets, church area, and waterfront spots, taking your time for careful compositions.

schedule.title: Luxury Dinner & Nightfall Reflections
schedule.description: Finish with a fine meal in an upscale restaurant, watching the village lights slowly appear on the surface of the lake.

low.title: Low-Budget Veggie Art Day in Hallstatt
low.summary: A relaxed full-day art route with vegetarian-friendly bites, beautiful streets, and scenic lake views that stay easy on the wallet.

schedule.title: Bakery Breakfast + Lake Walk
schedule.description: Grab a simple veggie-friendly pastry or bread roll and walk along the lakefront to wake up with the view.

schedule.title: Old Town Artistic Corners
schedule.description: Explore narrow lanes, wooden balconies, and painted façades — everything feels like a handmade model village.

schedule.title: Veggie-Friendly Snack Pause
schedule.description: Take a pause with a simple salad, cheese sandwich, or fries from a modest spot.

schedule.title: Church Area & Upper Viewpoint
schedule.description: Climb towards the parish church for a calm, high view over the houses and the lake.

schedule.title: Budget Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Find a place offering vegetarian pasta, salads, or basic hot dishes at reasonable prices.

schedule.title: Artisan Shops & Street Details
schedule.description: Window-shop for ceramics, wood pieces, and local crafts — great visual inspiration even if you don’t buy anything.

schedule.title: Sunset Veggie Snack by the Water
schedule.description: Pick up a small snack or takeaway and enjoy it while watching the last colors on the lake.

medium.title: Balanced Veggie Art Day
medium.summary: A comfortable full-day plan with art, architecture, and healthy vegetarian-friendly meals in cozy spots.

schedule.title: Light Café Breakfast
schedule.description: Start with a coffee, tea, or juice plus a vegetarian pastry or small breakfast plate.

schedule.title: Hallstatt Art & Architecture Stroll
schedule.description: Circle around Marktplatz and the lakeside houses, focusing on colors, textures, and shapes.

schedule.title: Museum Visit – Visual Highlights
schedule.description: Walk through the most visually interesting parts of the World Heritage Museum, focusing on displays and storytelling panels.

schedule.title: Vegetarian Lunch Break
schedule.description: Pick a medium-priced restaurant with salads, pasta, risotto, or veggie-friendly sides.

schedule.title: Church Terrace & Quiet Corners
schedule.description: Head up to the church terrace and nearby paths for peaceful artful views over the rooftops.

schedule.title: Café & Sketch Time
schedule.description: Sit in a comfortable café, have a drink, and maybe sketch part of the skyline or lakeshore.

schedule.title: Evening Lakeside Veggie-Friendly Stop
schedule.description: End with a light evening bite or dessert that fits a vegetarian diet while watching the reflections on the water.

high.title: High-End Veggie Art Journey in Hallstatt
high.summary: A refined art-themed day paired with creative vegetarian meals and the town’s best scenic spots.

schedule.title: Stylish Veggie Breakfast
schedule.description: Begin at a nicer café with a proper vegetarian breakfast — think fresh bread, jams, eggs or cheese, and good coffee or tea.

schedule.title: Museum & Cultural Art Tour
schedule.description: Explore the museum carefully, focusing on design, exhibits, and the way history is visually presented.

schedule.title: High-Quality Veggie Lunch
schedule.description: Choose a place where vegetarian dishes are clearly marked and presented with care — maybe pasta, veggie schnitzel, or creative mains.

schedule.title: Skywalk Panorama for Artists
schedule.description: Go up to the Skywalk to enjoy a huge open view that’s perfect for photography or quick landscape sketches.

schedule.title: Calm Mountain or Village Café Break
schedule.description: Take a pause with a hot drink or juice while enjoying the mountain or lake backdrop.

schedule.title: Artful Church & Old Town Loop
schedule.description: Make a loop through the church area, small stairways, and tight alleys that offer layered, artistic cityscapes.

schedule.title: Elegant Veggie Dinner by the Lake
schedule.description: Finish with a well-presented vegetarian dinner in a restaurant with a scenic view.

comfortable.title: Luxury Vegetarian Art Day in Hallstatt
comfortable.summary: A premium, curated vegetarian-friendly art experience with fine food, scenic churches, and world-class viewpoints.

schedule.title: Luxury Veggie Breakfast with View
schedule.description: Start with a generous breakfast in a high-end hotel or stylish café overlooking the lake or square.

schedule.title: Curated Museum & Culture Visit
schedule.description: Take a calm, detailed look at the museum’s best exhibits, focusing on design, lighting, and storytelling.

schedule.title: Fine Vegetarian Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a refined vegetarian menu with creative dishes, careful plating, and relaxed service.

schedule.title: Skywalk & Mountain Art Scenery
schedule.description: Head up to the Skywalk and surrounding paths to enjoy a grand, open landscape that feels like a giant painting.

schedule.title: Elegant Café or Lounge Stop
schedule.description: Pause in a more upscale café for a sweet or savory snack with a drink — all vegetarian-friendly.

schedule.title: Exclusive Old Town & Church Views
schedule.description: Spend time in the quietest, most photogenic corners of the village, focusing on composition and details.

schedule.title: Premium Veggie Dinner & Evening Reflections
schedule.description: End the day with a luxury-level vegetarian dinner while the village lights begin to glow on the lake.

low.title: Low-Budget Art + Tasting Day in Hallstatt
low.summary: A playful full day mixing small bites, pretty views, and artful village corners without spending too much.

schedule.title: Bakery Tasting Start
schedule.description: Pick 1–2 small pastries or rolls from a local bakery and eat them while checking out the lakeside houses.

schedule.title: Old Town Mini Art Hunt
schedule.description: Walk the central streets looking for carvings, signs, balconies, and doorways with personality.

schedule.title: Snack-Style Brunch
schedule.description: Grab another small bite — maybe a soup, fries, or sandwich — instead of one big meal.

schedule.title: Church Viewpoint & Photo Spots
schedule.description: Head up to the church area for layered rooftop views and creative angles over the lake.

schedule.title: Budget Tasting Lunch
schedule.description: Try a couple of simple local dishes in smaller portions or shared plates with others.

schedule.title: Sweet Treat Stop
schedule.description: Reward yourself with ice cream or a cheap dessert while people-watching on the promenade.

schedule.title: Relaxed Evening by the Lake
schedule.description: End the day sitting at the water’s edge, finishing any leftover snacks and enjoying the scenery.

medium.title: Balanced Art & Tasting Full Day
medium.summary: A fun mix of multiple small dishes, photogenic locations, and classic Hallstatt viewpoints at mid-range prices.

schedule.title: Café Breakfast Tasting
schedule.description: Try two or three smaller breakfast items — a pastry, some bread, maybe a small side — plus a drink.

schedule.title: Old Town & Lakeside Art Walk
schedule.description: Move between the main square, lakeside paths, and narrow alleys, taking photos and noticing details.

schedule.title: Museum Highlights Visit
schedule.description: Visit the museum for a focused look at the most interesting rooms and exhibits.

schedule.title: Medium Tasting Lunch
schedule.description: Order a couple of smaller plates or share dishes to experience more flavors in one meal.

schedule.title: Church Terrace & Viewpoint Loop
schedule.description: Walk up to the church terraces and side paths for classic skyline and lake compositions.

schedule.title: Dessert + Drink Break
schedule.description: Stop in a café for cake, strudel, or another small treat with coffee or hot chocolate.

schedule.title: Sunset Walk & Final Snack
schedule.description: Take a slow walk along the lake with one last small snack or street-food style bite.

high.title: Premium Art & Tasting Day in Hallstatt
high.summary: A refined day combining Hallstatt’s best artful views with several high-quality tasting-style meals.

schedule.title: High-End Breakfast Tasting
schedule.description: Sample several small breakfast items in a quality café — different breads, spreads, and sweets.

schedule.title: Museum & Culture Tour
schedule.description: Spend time in the museum appreciating the way objects are displayed and lit, almost like an art gallery.

schedule.title: Premium Tasting Lunch
schedule.description: Choose a restaurant that offers small courses or the option to share, so you can taste multiple dishes.

schedule.title: Skywalk & Mountain Panorama
schedule.description: Head up to the Skywalk to enjoy a massive panoramic view that feels like standing inside a painting.

schedule.title: Rooftops & Church Art Route
schedule.description: From the upper church area, slowly make your way back down through the village, catching every interesting angle.

schedule.title: Specialty Dessert Stop
schedule.description: Visit a place known for its desserts or coffee specialties and try something a bit more refined.

schedule.title: Evening Tasting-Style Dinner
schedule.description: Finish with a premium dinner made of several smaller courses inspired by regional cuisine.

comfortable.title: Luxury Art & Tasting Journey in Hallstatt
comfortable.summary: A full luxury experience where you sample multiple refined dishes, enjoy world-class views, and explore Hallstatt like a curated open-air gallery.

schedule.title: Luxury Breakfast Tasting
schedule.description: Begin with a series of premium breakfast bites and drinks in an upscale hotel restaurant or top café.

schedule.title: Curated Museum & Cultural Experience
schedule.description: Take a slow, detailed walk through the museum as if it were an art gallery, appreciating arrangement and atmosphere.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Tasting Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a multi-course tasting lunch that creatively reimagines local ingredients and traditional dishes.

schedule.title: Skywalk & Upper Hallstatt Exploration
schedule.description: Head up to the Skywalk and nearby viewpoints, giving yourself time for careful photography and quiet moments above the town.

schedule.title: Exclusive Old Town Art Walk
schedule.description: Return to the village and move through the most beautiful streets, balconies, and squares, like a private open-air exhibition.

schedule.title: High-End Dessert & Lounge Break
schedule.description: Visit a refined café or lounge for elegant desserts and a relaxed end-of-afternoon atmosphere.

schedule.title: Signature Tasting Dinner & Night Views
schedule.description: Close the day with a luxury tasting menu in a restaurant overlooking the lake, watching the village slowly light up after dark.
